name: cpp-inheritance-graph
description: Interactive, theme-aware visualization of C++ class inheritance for a header file or a whole directory.
author: Vladimir Fekete

commands.title: Show C++ Inheritance Graph for File
Show C++ Inheritance Graph for Folder

commandPalette.when: editorLangId == cpp || editorLangId == c || editorLangId == cuda-cpp

editor/context.when: editorLangId == cpp || editorLangId == c || editorLangId == cuda-cpp

cppInheritanceGraph.headerExtensions.description: File extensions treated as headers when scanning a folder.

cppInheritanceGraph.folder.recursive.description: When showing the graph for a folder, also include headers in its sub-folders.

enumDescriptions: Follow base classes defined anywhere in the open workspace folders (plus additionalScopeRoots).
Like 'workspace', and also follow into every non-system include directory.
Only follow base classes defined inside the selected folder (or the directory of the selected file).
cppInheritanceGraph.traversalScope.description: Base classes defined outside this scope are shown as external leaves and not expanded further.

cppInheritanceGraph.additionalScopeRoots.description: Extra directories whose classes are expanded like workspace classes. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

cppInheritanceGraph.includePaths.description: Additional include directories (on top of c_cpp_properties.json, compile_commands.json and C_Cpp.default.includePath). Supports ${workspaceFolder} and a trailing /** for recursive search.

cppInheritanceGraph.compileCommands.description: Path to compile_commands.json (or its directory). When empty, common build directories are searched and C_Cpp.default.compileCommands is used.

cppInheritanceGraph.fuzzyIncludeResoluti.description: If an #include cannot be resolved through the include paths, look for a header with a matching path suffix anywhere in the scope roots.

cppInheritanceGraph.externalNamespaces.description: Namespaces whose types are always treated as external leaves (traversal stops there).

cppInheritanceGraph.maxDepth.description: Maximum number of inheritance levels to follow upwards from the starting classes.

cppInheritanceGraph.languageServer.enabl.description: Ask the active C++ language server (Microsoft C/C++ IntelliSense, clangd, ...) to resolve base classes the built-in parser could not find (go-to-definition), and to report supertypes when it supports type hierarchy.

cppInheritanceGraph.languageServer.timeo.description: Timeout for a single language-server request.

enumDescriptions: Use clang-uml when the executable is found; silently fall back to the built-in parser on failure.
Always use clang-uml and report an error if it fails.
cppInheritanceGraph.clangUml.mode.description: Use clang-uml (compiler-accurate: macros, templates, hidden includes) to gather inheritance information.

cppInheritanceGraph.clangUml.extraArgs.description: Extra compiler flags passed to clang-uml for the synthetic translation unit (e.g. "-std=c++20").

cppInheritanceGraph.cppStandard.description: C++ standard for clang-uml (e.g. c++20). Empty: taken from compile_commands.json / c_cpp_properties.json, else c++17.

cppInheritanceGraph.navigateOn.description: In the graph, which mouse action jumps to the clicked class / method / field declaration. A single click always selects and highlights. Ctrl/Cmd+click always navigates.

cppInheritanceGraph.showMembers.description: Initial member visibility in the graph.

enumDescriptions: Generalization: derived class to base class (solid line, hollow triangle).
Realization: inheritance from an interface, i.e. only pure virtual methods and no data (dashed line, hollow triangle).
Composition: member by value, unique_ptr, optional, containers of values (filled diamond at the owner).
Aggregation: shared_ptr, containers of pointers (hollow diamond at the owner).
Association: raw pointer / reference members, weak_ptr (open arrow).
Dependency: class used only in method parameters or return types (dashed, open arrow).

cppInheritanceGraph.relations.description: UML relationships shown when a graph opens. They can be toggled in the graph's Relations menu.

enumDescriptions: Collect classes without any inheritance relation into collapsible groups per namespace.
Collect them into collapsible groups per source folder.
Show them as individual boxes packed into a grid below the hierarchies.
cppInheritanceGraph.standaloneClasses.description: How classes that neither derive from anything nor are derived from (in the current graph) are shown. Groups with more than 8 classes start collapsed.

cppInheritanceGraph.layoutDirection.description: Initial layout direction: base classes on top (TB) or on the left (LR).

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --out dist/
